guard: the Pi event holder does not adopt or publish while disconnected, captures its source boundary before a new turn, and defers an adopted holder's flush until reconnection

mutations.name: L1 adopt immediately at event-plane creation while the mesh is down
mutations.expectRed: C1: nothing published while the mesh is down

mutations.name: L2 drop the captured source boundary so an initial read starts at the later history end
mutations.expectRed: C2: a complete turn after createPiEvents publishes frames, not history

mutations.name: L3 flush an adopted holder during a post-adopt disconnect
mutations.expectRed: C3: reconnect drains the post-adopt durable records without halting
